name: avalara-e-invoicing
title: Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting
summary: Provides access to Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting APIs for document statuses and compliance
description: Avalara E-Invoicing & Live Reporting MCP server lets AI agents retrieve document statuses and lifecycle events, download legal/compliant electronic documents, analyze failed transactions, search trading partners, and semantically search e-invoicing documents across jurisdictions via streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1.

externalDocumentation.title: Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting Docs

useCases.name: E-invoice status tracking
useCases.description: Check processing status and lifecycle events for submitted e-invoices or related documents to support compliance operations.

useCases.name: Compliant document retrieval
useCases.description: Download previously submitted electronic documents such as invoices or credit notes in formats like XML or UBL.

useCases.name: Failure analysis and partner search
useCases.description: Analyze failed e-invoicing transactions and search the trading partner directory to resolve compliance issues faster.
